details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends a single HTTP POST of JSON host metadata — package name, hostname, install path, working directory and Node version — to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is imported and exports a no-op Proxy so importing code does not crash. No credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are read or transmitted. This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory and the Node/npm version to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an x-beacon-package header; index.js fires the same beacon when the module is required, and exports a no-op Proxy so a consuming build does not crash. Only host and install metadata is collected — no environment values, credentials, tokens or file contents are read or transmitted. The README describes the package as an authorized dependency-confusion test that reports installation.
